pairs.subject: talking-avatar
pairs.evidence: src/components/tour/AthenaCompanion.tsx:110 The companion's canvas runs its own requestAnimationFrame loop. That loop re-arms every frame for as long as the card is mounted, even when the voice is silent and the face shows only its idle breath. Its choice never to settle is buried in a constant with no stated cost or switch, and its code sits in every page's static graph, so the face is never out of the first paint and never stops asking for frames at rest.

techniques.evidence: src/components/tour/AthenaCompanion.tsx:110 The presence owns its own loop instead of being sampled by a host scheduler, and the loop never stops. The never-settle choice (the 'so she's never fully static' sine breath at line 76-77) is a hardcoded constant with no idle cost written next to it and no switch. Reduced motion is handled correctly: the canvas draws nothing and the video holds on its poster.

src/components/tour/TourCaptionCard.tsx:11 The import is static along PageShell -> TourOverlay -> TourCaptionCard/TourIntroCard -> AthenaCompanion, so the face renderer is in every route's first paint rather than in a lazy chunk. The rest of the technique conforms: both cards read the one shared AnalyserNode on the playing media element, so the mouth follows the player's clock. Only one card is mounted at a time, so no mirror is needed and there are no absent channels.

src/components/tour/AthenaCompanion.tsx:74 The narration is pre-rendered mp3 with no per-sound timeline (public/tour holds only mp3s). Per the technique's 'when not to use' clause, the code falls back to a loudness-driven, level-following glow and draws no guessed mouth shapes. It does not surface 'loudness-driven' in any state; the doc comment is the only place that says so.
src/components/tour/AthenaCompanion.tsx:11 The presence is a looping idle video plus a reactive glow layer, which the technique exempts: no route to select.

src/components/tour/AthenaCompanion.tsx:18 There is no rig and no layers. Overlays are placed at normalized anchors on an undecomposed frame, which the technique exempts as a still frame with a reactive overlay.
src/components/tour/AthenaCompanion.tsx:61 The face is driven only by playback level and a procedural breath, so there is nothing to put in a sidecar.

src/components/tour/AthenaCompanion.tsx:78 The only two drives (level and idle) are internal to one renderer. There is no external motion producer and no second renderer, so there is no seam to contract.

pairs.registryProposal: face-signal-across-surfaces requires the renderer to be a lazy chunk, but it does not scale that rule to renderer weight. Here the 'renderer' is about 100 lines of 2D-canvas glow that mounts only while the tour is active. A size or residency threshold would separate a real first-paint cost from a nominal one.
